title: Per Project vs Per Seat
subtitle: One social graphic — Maude Cloud's flat per-project price against Figma's climbing per-seat price
brief: Static social share image (Bluesky + LinkedIn) for the Maude Cloud free-pilot announcement. Single argument: Maude Cloud is €19/mo per project (unlimited people), Figma is priced per seat ($16 Professional / $55 Organization) — so a growing team's Figma bill climbs while Maude's stays flat. Numbers verified by the owner; landscape 1.91:1 for both platforms.
